correctness.rationale: The symbolic proof distinguishes all cyclic starting phases, obtains the exact ordinary factor count, and classifies T collisions through the unique zero-gap representation. All boundary conditions and quantifiers \(a,b,k,n\geq1\) are addressed. An independent direct-delete and zero-gap recurrence checker passes 15,810 finite cases; finite checks support but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The exact spectrum and unique collision classification provide a new structural answer for a natural infinite two-parameter periodic family under a recently studied word-complexity invariant. For singleton 1-runs, all iterations exhibit periodic collapse and a sharp minimal recovery threshold, quantitatively refining the general bounded-deficit literature. The result is motivated by the precise gap left by published qualitative bounds and is not a generic restatement of the ordinary factor complexity.
